caption: The drawing depicts a metal coffee pot with a conical body, a long, curved spout on the left, and a rounded handle on the right. The coffee pot is predominantly dark red or maroon in color, and its surface is decorated with a floral motif that includes large red and orange flowers with yellow accents, surrounded by green leaves and yellow highlights. The lid of the pot is dome-shaped and decorated with a pattern of alternating yellow and green shapes around the edge. The base and the rim of the lid also display a repeating scalloped pattern in green and yellow. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white paper, and the artist’s signature “FRANKLIN SYRES” appears to the lower right of the pot.
title: Toleware Tin Teapot
